rationale: Frameless non-resizable BrowserWindow geometry shrinks by 16x8 insets, with a gist. #50783 reports the same Windows 16x8 inset shrink and may be linked tentatively although frame:true and reported-versus-visible bounds differ. #51244 and #51679 instead describe inflation/outward growth, and the remaining candidates depend on Wayland or elevated scale; related geometry alone is insufficient.
